notes: Runner: local; no running compose app container was discovered. Own linked worktree deliberately checked out exact PR head and later restored to cez/b10f417e. No source edits, source commits/pushes, merges, migrations on developer DB, shared QA metadata or QA/pipeline label changes.

Fixtures: own two organizations, narrow role and distinct users A/B, own denied user; separate own tenantB/user with authorized group control; own products/policies/customer groups/customers/memberships. All disposed with owned ephemeral database. Seed admin/superadmin used only as provisioning/control actors, not as negative isolation actors.

No product soft-delete API exists for this customer path: DELETE people hard-deletes. Existing soft-deleted customer and orphan states were prepared by ID/tenant-scoped SQL only against the disposable database; marked API/DB fixture. PostgreSQL suite also independently covered lock/orphan paths.

Injected transport, message-less HTTP500, long error and escaped HTML-like text checks are deliberately synthetic client-boundary tests; real organization errors and ACL revocation were separately observed without interception.

Harness corrections: root Jest TS5011 resolved by repository core config; i18n tsx IPC EINVAL resolved by short TMPDIR. Early group assertions wrongly treated DELETE people as soft-delete and included the expected updated_at timestamp alias; subsequent scoped fixture/unique-second-user-change runs passed. Empty ACL scope is rejected by dispatcher403 before availability handler, so resolver-empty fallback is unit-covered, not claimed as live handler coverage.
Decimal-comma money checks inapplicable: changed policy fields are integers; no monetary mutation changed. No .uxproof contract directory exists.

Teardown initially stopped app but left exact owned DB container; local ignored helper repaired with recorded exact container ID, rerun and idempotency verified. Automatic review rejected a broad rm-style cleanup command; only whitelisted owned temporary files/caches were then removed safely.
gaps: Person/company membership dialogs could not be exercised: both Groups tabs absent after62 seconds for own authorized actor; unchanged registration/page spot mismatch. Membership setup was API-only.
Persistent customer_groups lifecycle/membership event delivery and downstream subscriber refresh were not observed. Database retirement, HTTP list refresh and PostgreSQL locking were verified.

Full state matrix ran on create-preview; edit-preview positive consumer verified. Edit-specific rejection, transient group loading and policy-list UI rejected-selection state were not independently isolated (all three read APIs returned real422).
Only English and Polish were driven in the browser. New error keys exist in en/pl/es/de/ko and translation sync passes.
No full repository CI gate or hosted-CI success is claimed. Evidence-only; this run grants no QA approval.
